🌟 GarmentCode | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Designing and generating parametric sewing patterns for customizable garments.
✨ Key Features: • Modular programming framework for parametric sewing patterns • PyGarment core library with base types and operators • Design of garment components and interfaces • Support for body measurements and design presets • Online configurator demo (GUI)
📖 Summary: GarmentCode is a Python framework for designing parametric sewing patterns. It provides a library (PyGarment) for defining garment components and their relationships, enabling the creation of customizable and adaptable clothing designs. The project also includes a dataset of 3D garments and a configurator GUI for interactive design.
